description: 根据主体、场景、平台、时长、风格、运镜和展示重点，生成适合 Seedance 的视频创作方案、参数建议和英文视频 Prompt。

douyin.name: 抖音
douyin.style_note: 节奏直接，前三秒突出主体和卖点。

xiaohongshu.name: 小红书
xiaohongshu.style_note: 生活方式和质感并重，强调细节、真实感和氛围。

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.style_note: 节奏轻快，开头要有动作变化或视觉钩子。

instagram_reels.name: Instagram Reels
instagram_reels.style_note: 强调镜头美感、生活方式和分享感。

ecommerce.name: 电商详情页
ecommerce.style_note: 重点展示主体、材质、细节、使用方式和可信购买信息。

lookbook.name: 品牌 Lookbook
lookbook.style_note: 节奏克制，强调品牌调性、轮廓、质感和整体造型。

parameter_suggestions.note: 这些是产品层参数建议，真实 API 字段和枚举值需要以 Seedance 官方文档为准。

camera_movements: clean transition between detail and wide view
default_camera_movement: slow push-in, smooth tracking shot, close-up detail shot
actions: subject remains centered while the camera slowly pushes in
model turns to show the side profile
model gently adjusts the collar or sleeve
product rotates slightly to reveal surface details
camera moves from close-up detail to a wide hero view
aerial camera glides over the scene
soft transition from establishing shot to detail shot
default_action: subject remains centered while the camera slowly pushes in, then transitions to a clear detail view
default_lighting: soft studio lighting with clean shadow contrast
image_to_video_note: If a reference image is provided, preserve the main subject identity, color, material, shape, proportions, and key visual details from the reference image.
avoid: visible logo unless requested and authorized
prompt_suffix: Keep the main subject clear and consistent throughout the video, with stable motion, realistic perspective, coherent lighting, professional composition, and no watermark.
